digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm runner module / structured-output execution cluster
propositions: runner.py sits at exactly the 800-LOC hard cap with zero headroom, so any added line fails the CI module-size gate.
This blocker prevents stories 2932 (Bedrock capability check) and 343b (verdict provenance) from adding lines to runner.py.

Extract the structured-output execution cluster (_pai_structured, _extract_usage, _warn_if_zeroed_usage, effective_max_iterations, effective_max_tokens, _FAULTY_OUTPUT_SNIPPET_CHARS) into a new leaf module structured_run.py, ~148 lines moved.
structured_run.py must have no runtime import from runner; RunRequest is referenced only under TYPE_CHECKING via future annotations, keeping direction runner -> structured_run.
The change is a pure relocation with no behaviour change; the full existing suite (7517 tests) must still pass with only import-site and string-literal patch-target edits.
Reference sites must be found by both a symbol-reference query and a string-literal grep, since monkeypatch string targets like runner_mod._pai_structured cannot be resolved by an LSP.
